save_pretrained_basic: save a PyTorch model to a local directory with model.safetensors and README.md files
save_pretrained_with_config: save a PyTorch model with a custom config dictionary to a local directory
from_pretrained_model_from_hub: load a PyTorch model from the Hugging Face Hub with safetensors fallback to pickle
push_to_hub: push a PyTorch model with config to a Hugging Face Hub repository
generate_model_card: generate a model card with custom template, metadata, and kwargs for a PyTorch model
